en.title: summer project
en.body: Lydia (UG, Biochemistry) spent this summer with us. During her project, she successfully created a range of constructs, transformed them into E. coli and B. subtilis, imaged the cells using fluorescence microscopy, and analysed the resulting data. We were very pleased to have you in the lab over the summer, Lydia, and wish you all the best in your future studies and career!
en.summary: Lydia (UG, Biochemistry) spent this summer with us...
